title: A sprint whose items touch a new _tools/test_*.py file is not refused as operator-present only, so the headless run stalls on the guard that denies that new file
goal: bl_authority.guarded_touches reports a touch that matches the new-test-file rule of kb_hook.headless_guard (NEW_TEST_FILE: a _tools/test_*.py that does not exist yet) as guarded, so runner start and the sprint start treat a sprint holding such an item as operator-present only, instead of starting it and stalling the run; an existing test file stays unguarded. Planted tests (name guarded_touches_new_test_file): a touch of a missing _tools/test_x.py is guarded, a touch of an existing test file is not, a glob is judged by what it matches today. Open items it affects: TK-dtybnlcg (test_bl_ci.py), TK-urxtzpya (test_bl_view.py), BG-v75r53iu (test_bl_bounds_intake_hook.py). Found by the SP-j6hh2ib2 review (gap 2).

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import bl_authority as b; sys.exit(0 if b.guarded_touches({'touches':['_tools/test_brand_new.py']}) else 1)

repro_reason: the defect is one function's answer for a path that does not exist yet; the call shows it returns an empty list
